metric: BEIR nDCG@10 (English reranking), as published in reranker technical reports/model cards
label: BEIR Reranking nDCG@10
note: From the jina-reranker-v3.5 (arXiv 2607.18152) and jina-reranker-v3 papers, which publish a shared BEIR nDCG@10 comparison table against contemporary rerankers. Cohere Rerank 3.5 and Voyage rerank-2.5 were investigated but excluded: neither publishes an absolute BEIR/nDCG@10 figure comparable to this table, only self-reported relative outperformance percentages that were not even internally consistent across the vendor's own reported comparisons — converting those into a synthetic score would be exactly the kind of interpolation the integrity rule rules out, so they're left out rather than guessed.
